long_biography.plain_text:
Good Deeds Day has become Shari Arison's most visible public initiative. Launched through Ruach Tova, the annual volunteering programme expanded from Israel to more than 115 countries, placing practical community service at the centre of her philanthropic work.

Arison also developed the Doing Good Model, a framework of 13 values intended for businesses, non-profits, communities and individuals. She has carried the model into workshops, books and digital projects. The Ted Arison Family Foundation provides an institutional base for much of this activity, while her son Jason now chairs the foundation.
